headline: Ginni Filaments announces special window for relodgement of physical share transfers
summary: Ginni Filaments Limited has informed the stock exchange about a special window for the relodgement of physical share transfers. This regulatory and administrative update pertains to shareholders holding physical certificates. Such procedural windows allow investors to regularize legacy share transfers in compliance with current norms. Retail investors holding physical shares in the company can utilize this facility.
why_it_matters: Procedural update for physical share holders

headline: Ginni Filaments files financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
